act3/corruption_event.title: Pulse of Corruption
act3/corruption_event.body:
A green **crystal** pulses. The dungeon's echo answers — a pulse that does not ask permission.

For a moment **Morvayn** sounds like a count, not a name: someone below is measuring hearts.

choices.preview: Let the pulse in — the dungeon signs its name on you.

choices.text: Pull back before the pulse finds you whole
choices.preview: Your body keeps humming; the price is nerve, not skin.

choices.text: Turn your back — pretend the green does not exist
choices.preview: Nothing changes now; the next rest may cost faith.
diaryTexts: I turned my back on the crystal. The pulse did not forgive — it only postponed.

act3/cult_passage.title: Cult Passage
act3/cult_passage.body: The torn map points where to fold — in a niche, **bones** bound with copper wire and a **bell shard** driven like a nail. The narrow passage smells of burned tallow.

choices.preview: Leave the niche untouched.
Gold and XP; cult recognition (once).
diaryTexts: The copper licked the coin and the air grew heavier — as if the tunnel had closed its ledger.

choices.text: The false map pulls toward ambush
choices.preview: The cult already waits.

act3/descent.title: Descent into Deep Silence
act3/descent.body:
The stair **sinks**. A green pulse beats with your heart — each flight steals noise until only wet stone remains. **No fire** is shelter here.

With the **Torn Map**, a shortcut opens that the common map hides.

choices.text: Continue to the heart of the depths
choices.preview: Drowned gallery and throne corridor.
False map — skill check or ambush.
Hidden path; needs rumor-map and level 7.
Green crystal; touch, retreat, or ignore.
Fix the smell before silence devours it.

choices.text: Listen to what Mira says of the smell and the silence
choices.preview: A voice that already signed with the depths.

act3/diary_trigger.title: Diary Entry
act3/diary_trigger.body: A feeling **writes** itself into the diary. You feel the ink's weight before you see the words.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The air smells of rotten copper.

act3/encounters/cult_ambush_scene.title: Cultist Ambush
act3/encounters/cult_ambush_scene.body: **Cultists** were already waiting for you. Their edge — steel decides the rest.

act3/encounters/cult_patrol_scene.title: Blind Messenger Patrol
act3/encounters/cult_patrol_scene.body: An eyeless **messenger** leads two acolytes down the corridor. The bell on his wrist marks time in dry beats.

choices.text: Strike before they ring the bell

act3/encounters/stone_combat_intro.title: Stone Against Flesh
act3/encounters/stone_combat_intro.body: Stone **against** flesh. The golem seals the path — three layers of armor before the real wound.

act3/encounters/vigil_hunter_scene.title: Lost Vigil Hunter
act3/encounters/vigil_hunter_scene.body: A Vigil **hunter**, covered in lime and soot, watches the passage as if he still obeyed a dead commander.

choices.text: Face the hunter in the dark

act3/flee_stone_guard.title: Flight — runes that tremble
act3/flee_stone_guard.body:
The golem **does not run**. It advances joint by joint, and each step shakes dust from the hall.

You retreat before the corridor becomes a tomb.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I retreated from the golem. The containment runes still tremble — stone does not forget who passed.

act3/flee_cult.title: Flight — hoods that laugh
act3/flee_cult.body:
The **hoods** do not run — they glide. You run with lungs still human.

A blade cuts air too near the ear; another scrapes pride without touching skin.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I fled the ambush. The Third Bell's echo stayed at the nape of my neck like a dirty nail.

act3/hub_depths.title: Heart of the Depths
act3/hub_depths.body:
The **core** is a drowned gallery: wet stone, bronze grates, and a corridor that drops toward the throne. **Morvayn** does not appear — but the air already carries his smell.

There is no campfire here. Only your breath and the slow drip of the walls.

choices.preview: Map — stress and possible encounters.
Runes, golem, and proof before the throne.
Chapter 4 — Morvayn.
choices.lockedHint: Level 11, guardian defeated, and map goal reached.

choices.text: Listen to the pipes under the stone
choices.preview: Luck; success gives a clue, failure costs supply.

choices.text: Speak with the cultist crossing the corridor
choices.preview: Pact, refusal, or steel; reputation shifts either way.
Stealth or combat; reputation shifts.
Ancient seal; class defines how it opens.

choices.text: The green you ignored calls a messenger
choices.preview: Consequence of ignoring the crystal.
Climb to the crossroads.

act3/lore/cult_negotiate.title: Pact Without Altar
act3/lore/cult_negotiate.body:
**Low voice**: *"Simple contract — you go down, we write the right name in the pipes. In exchange, **silence** outside the tunnel."*

The **cultist** holds an old coin — handler, not fanatic. Behind him, two others wait for the order.

choices.text: Show the Third Bell signet — ask favor at the margin of the contract
choices.preview: Gold and experience · cult recognition (once).
diaryTexts: The agent tilted his head like someone confirming a balance: the Bell remembers who pays twice.

choices.text: Accept the offer: pain for whisper
choices.preview: Circle +1, Vigil −1; gold in advance.
diaryTexts: I accepted coin I cannot return — and a name I will hear in the pipes when I descend further.

choices.text: [+] Refuse with the penitent's posture — return the coin intact
choices.preview: Vigil +1, faith +1; he withdraws, but records your face.
diaryTexts: I refused without theater; the cultist kept the coin like someone keeping a debt — so did I.

choices.text: Refuse — the Vigil recognizes your silence
choices.preview: Vigil +1; the cultist laughs dryly and vanishes.
diaryTexts: I did not say 'no' — I said the name of who sent me. That was enough for his silence.

choices.text: Rehearse each clause in a minimal voice — verbal confrontation (draft)
choices.preview: Tension and rolls; victory closes the pact as offered; failure leads to steel.
Immediate combat; no bargaining.
The cultist vanished into the pipes; the echo of the gesture remains.

act3/lore/cult_negotiate_verbal_fail.title: Pact Without Altar (steel)
act3/lore/cult_negotiate_verbal_fail.body: The bargain **breaks**. The handler whistles through his teeth; behind him, the pipe reminds you that silence also has teeth.

choices.preview: Immediate combat; no bargaining.

act3/lore/cult_negotiate_verbal_win.title: Pact Without Altar (word)
act3/lore/cult_negotiate_verbal_win.body: The handler steps half back. The coin vanishes into the sleeve. The contract was spoken — the tunnel still wants proof, but not in this fold.

choices.text: Descend with the contract in your head

onEnterDiaryTexts: The handler closed the tone without an altar — bargain in a minimal voice; the pipe deferred its teeth.

act3/messenger_cold_trail.title: Messenger Trail
act3/messenger_cold_trail.body:
Fresh **ash** under your boots and rope cut in haste: someone dragged a body here, then fought the tunnel.

At the end, two **cultists** count coins over an empty holster — Vigil crest still visible.

choices.preview: Avoid alarm — or fall into ambush.
Cultists in their den; steel speaks first.

act3/messenger_combat_intro.title: Cult in the Den
act3/messenger_combat_intro.body: Metal **wakes** before you. There is no talk left that is not blade.

act3/messenger_payoff.title: Dead Man's Inventory
act3/messenger_payoff.body: In the holster: a **list of names** with a scraped stamp and a bent sentinel **brooch**. You can return it to the order or turn it into coin in the network — each path charges a kind of silence.

choices.text: Leave the brooch and list where the Vigil will find them
choices.preview: Vigil +1 · little gold · the order thanks in silence.
diaryTexts: I returned to the beacon what the cult stole — without glory, with rent paid.

choices.text: Pass the package to the Circle — price and anonymity
choices.preview: Circle +1 · more gold · +1 corruption
diaryTexts: The Circle pays better for secrets than the Vigil pays for honor — and I charged the interest on my skin.

act3/messenger_stealth_roll.title: Silence in the Corridor
act3/messenger_stealth_roll.body: The corridor is too narrow for a mistake. One creak of armor and the messenger turns his head.
act3/messenger_stealth_roll.skillCheckLabel: Crawl without making your armor groan

act3/mira_descent_whisper.title: Whisper on the Descent
act3/mira_descent_whisper.body: **Mira** tips her head without looking at you: "Here silence is not peace. It is a **truce** between who rules the ceiling and who rules the floor. If you hear your name in the dark, do not be the first to answer."

choices.preview: The echo does not grow lighter — only more familiar.

act3/pipes_whisper.title: Pipes
act3/pipes_whisper.body: Between green-bronze **pipes**, the air scrapes a melody — voices from above, distorted, talking tax and descent as if they were the same word.
act3/pipes_whisper.luckCheckLabel: Hear the rumor in the pipe before the stone swallows it

act3/pipes_whisper_fail.title: Pipe That Bites
act3/pipes_whisper_fail.body: Condensation runs like acid; a cough rises from the pipe and stone bites the glove. You lose breath and a **pack** — the undercroft charges curiosity.

choices.text: Pull your hand free and retreat

onEnterDiaryTexts: The pipe was too hot — I burned time and supply listening to garbage.

act3/pipes_whisper_ok.title: Useful Echoes
act3/pipes_whisper_ok.body: You catch **one full phrase** before the wind cuts it: *"… close the grate on the fourth knock…"* — not a poem. An **instruction**.

choices.text: Write it down and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: The pipe lied about tone, but not meaning: someone above pays not to know who descends.

act3/secret/forgotten_shrine.title: Forgotten Shrine
act3/secret/forgotten_shrine.body:
Behind a cracked stone **veil** opens an antechamber missing from the map — low slabs, runes sealed in lead, still water that mirrors without reflecting.

In the center, a larger **rune**. No altar. Only the weight of whoever sealed this.

choices.text: Touch the central rune — remember silence before the name
choices.preview: Faith answers faith; the seal opens and leaves a light veil.
diaryTexts: The shrine accepted me — not as heroic visit, but as someone who closed the door before leaving. The ash veil stayed in my hands.

choices.text: [*] Whisper the contained formula — listen to what the seal keeps
choices.preview: Mind over rune; knowledge costs one supply.
diaryTexts: The rune did not ask for blood — it asked for attention. The notebook grew by a page I am not sure was mine.

choices.text: [!] Force it open — break the seal with steel
choices.preview: Steel against silence; gold and cost.
diaryTexts: I broke what asked for patience; the echo closed over me like a collar.

choices.text: [*] Aim at the rune joint — open without touching the center
choices.preview: Distance and precision; light stress, XP.
diaryTexts: I did not force the seal — I hit the joint. The shrine opened as one who respects those who do not come too close.

choices.text: Withdraw from the shrine without touching
choices.preview: Pretend you saw nothing.
diaryTexts: Some shrines ask to be left in peace — I pretended obedience for today.

choices.preview: The seal remembers you as you remember it.

act3/stone_corridor.title: Rune Corridor
act3/stone_corridor.body: Runes light. A funerary **golem** blocks the path to the throne. Cold stone, joint by joint.

choices.preview: Mirror truth avoids the trap — once.
diaryTexts: The well mirror did not lie: left avoids the stone tooth.

act3/stone_guard_victory.title: The Guardian Yields
act3/stone_guard_victory.body: The stone **cracks** with a dry snap. The corridor goes quiet. The tomb accepts the passage.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The guardian fell; the runes on the passage lost their pulse.

act3/stone_niche_loot.title: Votive Niche
act3/stone_niche_loot.body: Between two funerary plates, you find a niche with cold coins and dry resin. The altar protests in silence — without strength to stop you.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I scraped ancient coins from a votive niche before the dust swallowed them again.

act3/stone_rune_trial.title: Pulse of the Runes
act3/stone_rune_trial.body: The wall marks begin to **vibrate** when you bring your hand near. The corridor demands focus: master the old rhythm, or it invades the nerves.
act3/stone_rune_trial.skillCheckLabel: Match your breath to the stone's rhythm

act3/stone_rune_trial_fail.title: Echo in the Bones
act3/stone_rune_trial_fail.body: The wall's answer comes as a dry shock through the tendons. Your steps lag a half-beat behind.

choices.text: Pull back and catch your breath

onEnterDiaryTexts: I failed the runes' measure; my legs tremble with a cursed delay.

act3/stone_rune_trial_success.title: Rhythm Tamed
act3/stone_rune_trial_success.body: The runes' glow drops a tone. The weight in your skull eases, and every sound of the tomb arrives in order.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I tuned to the runes' pulse; for a little while, I think with more clarity.

act3/well_fail.title: Well's Deception
act3/well_fail.body: You trust the reflection. Something in the next room prepares a surprise.

act3/well_lies.title: The Well That Lied
act3/well_lies.body: The **Well That Lied** shows a map that does not match the walls. A lie carved for another pocket — every detour pays someone.
act3/well_lies.skillCheckLabel: Discern the map carved in stone

act3/well_success.title: Truth in the Mirror
act3/well_success.body: You see the **trick**: a shifted mirror. The real path opens left.
